remarks:
Tucked just minutes from downtown Bolivar, NY, this 12x32 seasonal camp—started in 2023—offers a thoughtfully designed retreat with a rustic, off-grid charm. Inside, you’ll find a bright living space highlighted by a sloped 13-foot ceiling and a propane heater to take the chill off cool summer evenings. The layout includes a bedroom spacious enough for a queen-sized bed, along with a loft that comfortably fits a twin mattress—perfect for guests or additional sleeping space.
The kitchen area provides generous counter space and features a gravity-fed sink, keeping things simple and functional. This property is ideal for those seeking a back-to-basics getaway, as it does not have a well or septic system. An outhouse is conveniently accessible via a walkway from the camp.
Power needs are supported by solar lighting, and the cabin is wired for a generator, with a dedicated shed for storage. Outside, you’ll also appreciate a fenced-in area for pets and a fire pit that sets the stage for relaxing evenings or entertaining under the stars.
If you’re looking for a peaceful escape with practical amenities and room to unwind, this Bolivar-area camp delivers.
